name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
summary: The Captured Scarlet Zealot is a crusader prisoner held captive in the basement of Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Watched over by Forsaken apothecaries and townsfolk, he serves as a living test subject for the Royal Apothecary Society's developing concoctions.

sections.title: A Bitter Captive in Brill
sections.body: Confined beneath Gallows' End Tavern, this member of the Scarlet Crusade embodies the unyielding fanaticism of his order. Even in chains, surrounded by the undead he views as an abomination, he offers no remorse and venomously denounces anyone who speaks to him—such as Renee Lauer, whom he reviles as a traitor. For the Forsaken, capturing a living zealot is not an act of mercy; it provides valuable human test material to evaluate the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development by Apothecary Johaan.

faq.q: Why is a Scarlet Zealot kept alive in Brill?
aliases: who is the zealot in brill cellar
faq.answer: The Forsaken keep him captive in the tavern basement as a living subject for testing new poisons and chemical agents developed by the Royal Apothecary Society.

faq.q: Where can I find this captive?
faq.answer: He is imprisoned in the damp cellar beneath Gallows' End Tavern, situated in the center of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: How does he react to the Forsaken around him?
faq.answer: He remains fanatically defiant despite his confinement, lashing out with insults and labeling locals like Renee Lauer traitors to humanity and the Light.

angles.text: To the Forsaken of Brill, this fanatic in chains represents the relentless crusaders seeking their extermination, serving a far more useful role as an apothecary's guinea pig.
Scarlet zealots claim exclusive dominion over the Holy Light, yet this prisoner's unwavering zeal offers no defense against the grim reality of Forsaken captivity.
